title: Spotlight Cafe Open Mic @ MOAH:CEDAR
event_description: Monthly open mic night featuring local musicians,  singers and performers. All talent welcome from music to poetry and dance. Featured performers have 5 minutes each. Equipment provided.
event_venue_information:
MOAH:CEDAR

Historic Arts Venue

Restored 1920s Cedar Center for the Arts complex featuring multiple performance and gallery spaces. MOAH:CEDAR is a catalyst for community engagement through exhibitions and performance art.

Music and Performance Events

Spotlight Cafe is the primary open mic venue. Features local musicians singers poets and performers with a welcoming inclusive environment. Maximum 5 minutes per performer. Two basic microphones and phone/MP3 playback plugin provided for performers. Amplifier power available.

Additional Venues at Cedar Center

Cedar Memorial Hall hosts monthly concert series with local artists. Free Figure Drawing classes and creative workshops held throughout the year.

title: Live Music Saturdays @ Big Shotz
event_description: Weekend rock and classic rock tribute bands performing live at this popular local bar and grill. Featuring local talent showcasing diverse styles from classic rock to current hits.
backline: Full PA system stage and lighting
event_venue_information:
Big Shotz Bar & Grill

Antelope Valley Home of Rock and Roll

Located in downtown Lancaster Big Shotz has established itself as the premier venue for live rock music in the Antelope Valley. The venue features regular weekend entertainment and is known locally as the AV's home of rock and roll.

Live Entertainment

Friday and Saturday nights feature live music performances. The venue hosts local and touring bands with special focus on rock classics and tribute acts. Full stage setup with professional PA system and lighting.

Food and Beverage

Full restaurant menu featuring Italian dishes New York style pizza burgers wings and salads. Full bar with affordable drink specials. Known for special deals including dollar wings and five dollar spaghetti on specific days.

Venue Amenities

Large outdoor covered patio area with ample seating. Multiple screens for sports viewing including NFL Sunday Ticket and Dodgers games. Pool tables arcade games and entertainment options. Community-focused venue hosting themed events and celebrations.
